verdicts.reason: Both are tiny 320x50 banners with the MERRY logo shrunk to a tiny size. A puts DISCOUNT in the middle with MERRY squeezed below it, which breaks the original reading order (MERRY then DISCOUNT) and leaves the brand word tiny. Its characters are scattered at the edges and look like fragments. B reads left to right with DISCOUNT leading and MERRY plus a character cluster after it. That is more coherent and compact, but MERRY is still tiny, DISCOUNT comes before MERRY, and the characters are crammed together. B is slightly less bad.
